topic: Why Apples Float in Water While Pears Immediately Sink
title: Why Apples Float While Many Pears Sink 🍎🍐
false_sentence: Freezing nights and warm days create pressure that pushes tree sap up.
correct_version: Root pressure and capillary action, combined with transpiration pull, are the primary mechanisms that move water and sap up through a tree.
why: The sentence about tree sap and pressure is scientifically inaccurate and irrelevant to why apples float and pears sink.
